name: GIIB Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，GIIB Holdings Berhad 签署谅解备忘录，拟在马来西亚半岛开发 Farizon 商用车 4S 中心枢纽，并拟有条件认购 Tricrest Foodie Trading 新股，此外，公司通过附加上市公告进行股份拆分，并披露多项重大诉讼及持续经营相关的保留意见。
overview_en: In 2026, GIIB Holdings Berhad entered into a memorandum of understanding to develop a 4S centre hub for Farizon commercial vehicles in Peninsular Malaysia, and proposed a conditional share subscription into Tricrest Foodie Trading, which holds exclusive distribution and branding rights for Wonlucky products in Malaysia. The company also undertook share subdivision via additional listing announcements and disclosed material litigation and a qualified opinion related to going concern.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 签署谅解备忘录拟开发 Farizon 商用车 4S 中心枢纽，并拟认购 Tricrest Foodie Trading 新股。
segments.note_en: Entered MOUs to develop a Farizon commercial vehicle 4S centre hub and to subscribe for new shares in Tricrest Foodie Trading.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 GIIB Project Management & Capital Sdn. Bhd. 与 Zhejiang Farizon Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd 及 CAF Motors Sdn. Bhd.
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary GIIB Project Management & Capital Sdn. Bhd. entered into an MOU with Zhejiang Farizon Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd and CAF Motors Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 GIIB Project Management & Capital Sdn. Bhd. 与 Tricrest Foodie Trading Sdn. Bhd. 签署谅解备忘录，拟有条件认购其新股。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary GIIB Project Management & Capital Sdn. Bhd. entered into an MOU with Tricrest Foodie Trading Sdn. Bhd. for a proposed conditional share subscription;

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 通过谅解备忘录拟进入商用车 4S 中心枢纽开发业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed entry into the development of a commercial vehicle 4S centre hub via an MOU.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 通过谅解备忘录拟认购 Tricrest Foodie Trading 新股，涉足 Wonlucky 产品在马来西亚的独家分销业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed subscription of new shares in Tricrest Foodie Trading via an MOU, involving exclusive distribution of Wonlucky products in Malaysia.
